name: aidcp-edge
description: AIDCP 边缘端：DOM-first 定位层引擎 + CDP（原生 WebSocket）页面接入（DomProvider / ActionExecutor）+ 边-云 WS 客户端（点赞垂直切片）。
author: AIDCP

scripts.build:dist: npm run clean:dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/prune-production-dist.mjs
scripts.electron:build: npm run verify:desktop-build-input && npm run build:dist && npm run build:ads-runtime && npm run build:native-page-engines-for-package && node ./node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js
scripts.electron:build:win: npm run verify:desktop-build-input && npm run build:dist && npm run build:ads-runtime && npm run build:native-page-engines-for-package -- x64 && node ./node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js --win
scripts.electron:build:mac: npm run verify:desktop-build-input && npm run build:dist && npm run build:ads-runtime && npm run build:native-page-engines-for-package -- x64 arm64 && node ./node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js --mac
scripts.electron:build:mac:dev: npm run verify:desktop-build-input && npm run build:dist && npm run build:ads-runtime && npm run build:native-page-engines-for-package -- x64 arm64 && node ./node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js --mac -c.extraMetadata.aidcpCloudDefaultEnv=dev -c.extraMetadata.aidcpClientAuthUrl=http://121.89.85.150:8088/capi
scripts.electron:build:mac:ol: npm run verify:desktop-build-input && npm run build:dist && npm run build:ads-runtime && npm run build:native-page-engines-for-package -- x64 arm64 && node ./node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js --mac -c.extraMetadata.aidcpCloudDefaultEnv=ol -c.extraMetadata.aidcpClientAuthUrl=https://aidcp.tommax.cc/capi
